entities.summary: An 18.1 km single-track crossing from the A896 at Tornapress over Bealach na Bà to the Applecross coast-road junction.
entities.description: This published section follows Highland Council road C1087 west from the A896, climbs the steep corrie and hairpins below the pass, then descends to Applecross. It is a narrow road with passing places and is exposed to weather-related restrictions; current conditions should be checked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: The route compresses a sea-level-to-high-pass crossing, unusually tight historic road engineering and a sudden west-coast reveal into a short but complete journey.

entities.summary: Britain's most concentrated high-thrill theme-park day, led by Hyperia and The Swarm but materially exposed to queues and ride downtime.
entities.description: Thorpe Park's reason to travel is the hardware: Hyperia, The Swarm, Stealth, Nemesis Inferno, Saw and supporting thrill rides create a dense enthusiast-oriented day. Current 2026 evidence also shows that the realised experience is unusually sensitive to crowd level and operational reliability.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Go when the forecast and crowd calendar are favourable and treat it as a coaster-focused day; the ceiling is high enough for a detour, but not reliable enough for A.

entities.summary: A characterful Abbeyhill pub whose scratch-made, globally playful food and unusually broad gluten-free choices make it a strong deliberate neighborhood pick.
entities.description: The Safari Lounge looks like a quirky local pub but current visitor evidence repeatedly treats the kitchen as the reason to choose it: fish, pork and beef tacos, changing globally inspired specials and gluten-free versions of much of the menu sit alongside local/real ale and the deliberately eccentric Tiger Room. It is not worth crossing Edinburgh for ahead of the city's strongest food destinations, but it now squarely fits Goodshit's neighborhood-worthy food publication path.
entities.whyWorthwhile: If you are around Abbeyhill, Meadowbank or the east end of Holyrood, choose it for a relaxed pub meal rather than interchangeable convenience; tacos and the changing scratch-made specials are the strongest recurring signal, especially for gluten-free diners.
